briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI push frontier model releases as compute constraints tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced models this month. Funding remains robust while safety concerns mount over production vulnerabilities.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4-preview while Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus. xAI's Grok-3 and Meta's Llama 4 variants show rapid capability gains. DeepSeek and Google DeepMind continue aggressive scaling.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement begins next quarter.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp faces delays. Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100 clusters in Texas and Nevada. TSMC reports record AI chip orders for Q4.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems with protocol-level defenses like DialectForge outpace traditional alignment approaches by 2028?
